title: Forecasting Voltage Time Series under Anomalies Using a WGAN Model With Lipschitz Control and Progressive Kernel Critic Strategy
abstract: arXiv:2610.23394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In time-series forecasting tasks, the use of recursive forecasting on high-dimensional data substantially increases the complexity of the prediction process. The main challenge is that long-term dynamics becomes harder to model, since the sequences show greater temporal variability. To counteract this limitation and improve the modeling of long-term dynamics, and more importantly, address high-dimensional recursive forecasting, this paper uses a Wasserstein GAN equipped with a progressive Lipschitz penalty and an adaptive kernel. This model is capable of taking a window of the data stream and forecasting the next values, subsequently reconstructing the time-series stream and dynamically adapting its kernel to each new window. The proopsed model is a deep learning framework based on a Wasserstein GAN (WGAN-CLP) with an adaptive kernel to model alterations in streaming voltage time series. translated_title: 使用具有Lipschitz控制和渐进核判别器策略的WGAN模型在异常情况下预测电压时间序列
translated_abstract: 在时间序列预测任务中，对高维数据使用递归预测会大幅增加预测过程的复杂性。主要挑战在于长期动态更难建模，因为序列表现出更大的时间变异性。为了克服这一局限并改进长期动态建模，更重要的是解决高维递归预测问题，本文采用了一种配备渐进Lipschitz惩罚和自适应核的Wasserstein生成对抗网络（GAN）。该模型能够接收数据流的一个窗口并预测后续数值，随后重建时间序列流，并针对每个新窗口动态调整其核。所提出的模型是一个基于Wasserstein GAN（WGAN-CLP）并结合自适应核的深度学习框架，用于对流电压时间序列中的变化进行建模。为了建立方法论基础，我们（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种结合渐进Lipschitz惩罚与自适应核的Wasserstein GAN模型（WGAN-CLP），用于在异常情况下对高维流电压时间序列进行递归预测和动态建模。
en_tdlr: A Wasserstein GAN model (WGAN-CLP) with progressive Lipschitz penalty and adaptive kernel is proposed for recursive forecasting and dynamic modeling of high-dimensional streaming voltage time series under anomalies.
